title: Esports World Cup 2027 Qualifier Program: Direct Qualifiers and Satellite Last Chance Qualifiers open to organisers, cafés and universities; applications until 20 Dec

sources.name: Esports World Cup, ESPORTS WORLD CUP 2027 QUALIFIER PROGRAM

claims.text: Two partner-operated routes: Direct Qualifiers and Satellite Last Chance Qualifiers

Satellite LCQ organisers include federations, associations, cyber cafés, universities, venues, festivals; winners get guaranteed entry into the EWC LCQ next summer with accommodation and visa support from the Esports Foundation
Applications open until 20 Dec 2026; Satellite events must conclude by 1 Jun 2027
Team Falcons entered Overwatch 2 through the LCQ before winning the title in 2025

notes: Missed by the email digests (internal scout found it). Not used: 1.8M players / 400 events (Tbreak only); the 2027 host city (not stated on the page). DeepL forward pass offered مقاهي الإنترنت for cyber cafés; kept مقاهي الألعاب.
